items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: The only playing I did with Pete was, you know, since these recent years. Yeah, I played on the job

ctx.x: Yeah, well, we can do it again. Anyway, what about the Creole Serenaders? Creole Serenaders? Did you ever play with them? Peter Boccage had them. Oh no, I never. You never played with them. I just wanted a few.
The only playing I did with Pete was, you know, since these recent years. Yeah, I played on the job, but I never was a member of his band. I see.
Oh, we were talking about the Tulane band and we never did get down who was in that band, who the different members were.
